item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Treat it as a routine you protect, not a task you remember when you can. Taking it at the same time each day, tied to something you already do, removes the guesswork. Notice how it affects your sleep, mood, and energy, and keep those observations short and honest. If something feels off, bring it to your prescriber instead of adjusting it yourself. Your action: set one daily reminder for your dose, right now.
